title: cyperus sanguinolentus f. melanocephalus
intro: Cyperus sanguinolentus f. melanocephalus, commonly known as black papyrus or purple papyrus, is a plant species in the sedge family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, fever, and pain. The health benefits of Cyperus sanguinolentus f. melanocephalus include its potential to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
